# SEO Skill for Zobique Labs

## Purpose
This skill helps optimize the Zobique Labs website for search relevance, business intent, trust, and lead generation. It is tuned for a B2B AI agency website that sells custom AI solutions, AI agents, copilots, and enterprise AI automation.

## Strategic objective
Target high-intent commercial queries that signal buying behavior, including:
- custom AI application development
- AI agent development company
- AI copilot development
- enterprise AI automation
- AI solutions for businesses

## Required behavior
When working in this repo:
- Improve metadata, headings, internal linking, and conversion-focused page structure.
- Keep page titles under 60 characters when possible and ensure they are unique.
- Keep meta descriptions concise and result-focused, ideally 140-160 characters.
- Use canonical URLs, robots rules, and sitemap configuration in production.
- Prefer semantic, service-specific page copy over generic business language.
- Add JSON-LD where relevant to strengthen entity and service discoverability.

## High-priority pages
- Homepage
- AI application development
- AI agent development
- AI copilot development
- Enterprise AI solutions
- About page
- Work / case studies
- Contact page
- FAQ page

## Quality bar
A page is considered SEO-ready when it has:
- clear keyword-focused title
- matching H1 and supporting H2s
- natural service terminology
- unique meta description
- canonical metadata
- internal links with descriptive anchor text
- strong CTA placement
- logical schema and technical configuration

## Audit checklist
Before considering SEO work complete, verify:
- no duplicate titles across pages
- no missing canonical URLs
- robots and sitemap are configured
- headings are structured for readability and keywords
- the home page clearly explains the service categories
- service pages explain the outcome, use case, and who it helps
- contact and CTA pathways are prominent

## Example commands
- Run a homepage SEO audit and list quick wins.
- Improve the AI agent development page for better commercial intent and conversion.
- Add structured data to the enterprise AI solutions page.
- Review internal linking across the service pages and improve anchor text.
- Optimize the site for top-of-funnel and high-intent commercial searches.
